_comment: Hand-written GroovyScript side-only config. Members under 'client' only exist on the client and are stripped from the class on the dedicated server. InfuseType's sprite/setIcon use the client-only TextureAtlasSprite: without stripping them, Groovy can't reflect the class on a server (preInit/mekanism.groovy) and GroovyScript's auto-detection writes every member, name included, into sideOnlyGenerated.json, which breaks the class on the next boot.
